name: Plugin name "claude-carbon" is reserved: it passes as one of Anthropic's own. A third party's plugin name cannot start with "claude-", "anthropic-", "anthropics-", or "cc-plugin-", be "claude", "anthropic", "anthropics", "claude-code", or "claude-mods", or put "official" beside "claude" or "anthropic". Name it for what it does. If this is one of Anthropic's own plugins, validate the marketplace that lists it.
